records.text: TSPAN 210 Accelerated Intermediate Spanish (5) A&H Merges SPAN 201 and SPAN 202. Designed to build listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills and to expand knowledge of culture and literature of the Spanish-speaking world. Combines classroom experience with accelerated Web-enhanced activities provided through Spain's Instituto Cervantes. records.text: TSPAN 352 Introduction to Hispanic Cultural Studies (5) A&H Acquaints students with different approaches to cultural studies, using key notions of elite, mass and folk culture of Spanish-speaking societies and examples.
